verdict.rationale: Salesmate is a CRM with AI features, so whether customer data can be excluded from AI model training is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions training opt-outs, data-usage policies or AI privacy controls. The AI-feature claims (docs-3, docs-12) describe capabilities, not data-use restrictions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
